title: Sensor Ingestion Service
description: Application and business metrics for the IoT sensor ingestion API (Part B).

panels.title: Stored readings / s
panels.description: Readings accepted and stored (outcome normal + anomaly), per second over the last minute. 20 devices × 1 reading / 5 s ≈ 4/s.

panels.title: p95 latency · POST /readings
panels.description: 95% of POST /readings requests over the last 1 minute finished within this time. Estimated from the latency histogram's buckets with histogram_quantile().

panels.title: Server errors (5xx)
panels.description: Share of all HTTP requests over the last minute that returned 5xx. Normally 0; rises when the error fault is injected.

panels.title: Rejected readings (422)
panels.description: Share of POST /readings attempts over the last minute rejected as invalid (not stored). The simulator's dev-019 sends invalid data ~30% of the time, so ~1.5% is normal here.

panels.title: Devices by status
panels.description: Current device count per status, computed at scrape time with the same rule as GET /devices.

panels.title: Fault injection
panels.description: Whether each fault type is switched on via /admin/faults (sensor_fault_active).

panels.title: Submit a reading: HTTP vs gRPC (A2)
HTTP calls per minute by status · POST /readings
panels.description: Requests in the last minute, by HTTP status: increase(sensor_http_requests_total[1m]). Measured on the server (RequestContextMiddleware).

panels.title: gRPC calls per minute by status · SubmitReading
panels.description: Calls in the last minute, by RPC method and gRPC status code: increase(sensor_grpc_requests_total[1m]). Measured on the server (ObservabilityInterceptor in app/grpc_server.py).

panels.title: Error rate · HTTP vs gRPC
panels.description: Share of calls that did not succeed over the last minute: non-2xx for HTTP, non-OK for gRPC. Includes client errors (422/INVALID_ARGUMENT, 409/ALREADY_EXISTS, 429/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED) as well as server errors (5xx/INTERNAL); the panels on the left show which.

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 · HTTP vs gRPC (window 1m)
panels.description: Server-side duration percentiles over a 1-minute window: histogram_quantile(q, sum by (le) (rate(<histogram>_bucket[1m]))). Both histograms use the same bucket bounds (app/metrics.py LATENCY_BUCKETS), so the two are directly comparable. Interpolated inside buckets, so read them as estimates.

panels.title: Calls in flight · HTTP vs gRPC
panels.description: Calls being handled right now (gauges sampled every 5 s). Chosen over message size because SubmitReading messages are a constant ~100 bytes; in-flight shows calls piling up when the server slows down. The HTTP gauge counts every route.

panels.title: Rate-limited and repeated submissions per minute
panels.description: Refused by the per-device rate limiter (sensor_rate_limited_total, 429 / RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED), and idempotent repeats (replayed) or conflicting repeats (conflict) by transport (sensor_readings_total). These were invisible in A1.

panels.title: Request rate by route
panels.description: HTTP requests per second, by route template (never the raw URL, so the number of series stays small).

panels.title: Latency percentiles · POST /readings
panels.description: p50 / p95 / p99 of POST /readings over a sliding 1-minute window, from the histogram buckets. Bucket bounds: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 75, 100, 250, 500 ms, 1, 2.5, 5 s; values between bounds are interpolated linearly.

panels.title: Responses by status code · POST /readings
panels.description: POST /readings responses per second, stacked by status code: 201 stored, 422 rejected, 500 failed.

panels.title: Apdex · POST /readings (T = 25 ms)
panels.description: Apdex user-satisfaction score from the latency histogram: (satisfied + tolerating/2) / total, where satisfied ≤ T = 25 ms and tolerating ≤ 4T = 100 ms. 1 = everyone satisfied, 0 = everyone frustrated.

panels.title: DB write time · Histogram (API + gRPC)
panels.description: Time to store one reading in SQLite, across both processes that write (API and gRPC server): average = sum(rate(_sum)) / sum(rate(_count)); p95 from the buckets. A2 changed this from a Summary, which can't be aggregated across processes, to a Histogram.

panels.title: Readings by outcome
panels.description: POST /readings attempts per second, stacked by outcome: normal and anomaly are stored, rejected = 422 (invalid, not stored), failed = 5xx (not stored).

panels.title: Devices by status
panels.description: Number of devices per status over time (ok / anomaly / stale). dev-020 turns stale for ~30 s every 2 minutes.

panels.title: Anomalies per minute by reason
panels.description: Anomaly reasons found on stored readings in the last minute. One reading can have several reasons.

panels.title: Validation errors per minute by field
panels.description: Field-level reasons for 422 rejections in the last minute (data quality). One rejected reading can fail several fields.

panels.title: Anomaly share of stored readings
panels.description: Share of stored readings flagged as anomalous over the last minute.

panels.title: Fault switches
panels.description: 1 while a fault type is switched on via /admin/faults (sensor_fault_active gauge).

panels.title: Faults injected per minute
panels.description: Requests hit by an injected fault in the last minute (sensor_faults_injected_total).

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Requests being handled at each scrape (sensor_http_requests_in_progress gauge). Includes the scrape itself.

panels.title: API process CPU and memory
panels.description: CPU (cores used) and resident memory of the API process, from prometheus_client's built-in process metrics.
